# Entrify

> Instant web deployment platform — paste a GitHub or GitLab repository URL and get a live subdomain URL. Entrify clones, containerizes, and hosts your app automatically.

Entrify is a self-hosted deployment platform that supports static sites, Node.js, Next.js, and Django applications. Each deployment runs in an isolated Docker container (static sites are served as files) at its own `<slug>.entrify.site` subdomain. Projects can be deployed from the web dashboard, the `entrify` CLI (npm package `entrify-deploy`), or from Claude Code with the `entrify` plugin.

Two processes run side by side: the Next.js web app (API + UI) and a BullMQ worker that processes build jobs asynchronously.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://entrify.site/docs/getting-started): Create a project, connect a git repository, and trigger your first deployment from the dashboard.
- [Git Setup](https://entrify.site/docs/git-setup): Connect GitHub and GitLab OAuth apps for private repository access. Tokens are stored encrypted and auto-refreshed for GitLab.
- [Local Dev](https://entrify.site/docs/local-dev): Run the Next.js dev server and BullMQ worker locally. Covers environment variables, Prisma setup, and Docker requirements.
- [Next.js](https://entrify.site/docs/frameworks/nextjs): Multi-stage Docker build (builder + runner stages). The config patcher adjusts `next.config.js` for standalone output automatically.
- [React / Vue / Svelte](https://entrify.site/docs/frameworks/static): Compiled to static files and served via Nginx.
- [Node.js](https://entrify.site/docs/frameworks/nodejs): `npm install --omit=dev` + `npm start`. Requires a `start` script in `package.json`.
- [Django](https://entrify.site/docs/frameworks/django): `pip install -r requirements.txt` + `manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000`.
- [FastAPI / Flask](https://entrify.site/docs/frameworks/fastapi): Python ASGI/WSGI apps with pip-based installs.
- [CLI Reference](https://github.com/kpndevrootentri/entrify-cli#readme): Install `entrify-deploy` (`npm install -g entrify-deploy`) and run `entrify deploy` in any git repo. Add `--json` to any command for one machine-readable JSON object; exit codes are 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 needs input, 3 not logged in.
- [Claude Code Integration](https://github.com/kpndevrootentri/entrify-cli#use-it-from-claude-code): Install the plugin with `/plugin install entrify --marketplace kpndevrootentri/entrify-cli`, then ask Claude to deploy. It deploys, reads the build log when a deploy fails, fixes the cause and redeploys.

## API

All authenticated routes require a valid JWT. Browser clients use an httpOnly session cookie. CLI and CI clients send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

- `POST /api/auth/register` — Create an account `{ email, password }`. Sets httpOnly cookie on success.
- `POST /api/auth/login` — Log in `{ email, password }`. Sets httpOnly cookie.
- `POST /api/auth/token` — CLI login. Same as `/login` but returns JWT in the response body (no cookie). Used by `entrify auth login`.
- `POST /api/auth/logout` — Clear the session cookie.
- `GET /api/auth/session` — Validate current session; returns `{ userId, email }`.
- `GET /api/auth/github/connect` — Start GitHub OAuth flow.
- `GET /api/auth/gitlab/connect` — Start GitLab OAuth flow.
- `GET /api/git-providers` — List connected providers (username + avatar).
- `DELETE /api/git-providers/:provider` — Disconnect a provider.
- `GET /api/git-providers/:provider/repos?q=&page=` — Search user's repos (Redis-cached).
- `GET /api/projects` — List all projects for the authenticated user.
- `POST /api/projects` — Create a project `{ name, githubUrl, type, branch }`. `type` is one of `STATIC | NODEJS | NEXTJS | DJANGO`.
- `GET /api/projects/:id` — Get project details including latest deployment status.
- `PATCH /api/projects/:id` — Update project settings.
- `DELETE /api/projects/:id` — Delete project and its containers.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/deploy` — Trigger a deployment. Returns `{ deploymentId }`. Build runs asynchronously.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/terminal` — Execute a command inside the running container `{ command }`. Validated against an allowlist; 30-second timeout.
- `GET /api/projects/:id/analytics` — 14-day traffic hits, device breakdown (mobile/desktop/bot).
- `GET /api/projects/:id/showcase` — Get public showcase config.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/showcase` — Publish or update the project's showcase listing.
- `GET /api/health` — Health check.

## Optional

- [Explore](https://entrify.site/explore): Public showcase of deployed projects with SEO metadata and JSON-LD structured data.
- [entrify-deploy on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/entrify-deploy): CLI package: `entrify deploy [--create]`, `status`, `logs [--follow]`, `env list|set|push|unset`, `rollback`, `cancel`, `projects`, `auth login`. Supports the `ENTRIFY_TOKEN` and `ENTRIFY_URL` env vars for CI.
- [Claude Code /deploy skill](https://entrify.site/deploy.md): The `/deploy` skill as one file, for saving to `~/.claude/commands/`. It installs the CLI, checks the login, deploys with `--json`, and fixes failed deploys (at most 3 attempts).
